connectionTest.tcpProxyOk: TCP connection to the proxy {{address}} established

servers.kindMismatch: The server looks like {{detected}}, but {{configured}} is selected in the installation
servers.unsupportedVersion: {{kind}} {{version}} is older than {{min}}: Glafira works with it as with an OpenAI-compatible server
servers.noMetricsSglang: SGLang does not expose metrics: start it with --enable-metrics
servers.noMetrics: The server does not expose its metrics at the metrics path of the installation

import.addressChanged: “{{name}}”, server “{{server}}”: the address changes from {{from}} to {{to}}. The saved API key will be sent to the new address.
import.proxyChanged: “{{name}}”, server “{{server}}”: the proxy settings change. The saved API key will go through the new proxy.
import.tlsChanged: “{{name}}”, server “{{server}}”: the certificate verification settings change. The saved API key will be used with the new settings.

installations.environment: Color and protection: a new prod installation is created read-only.
installations.readOnly: Glafira will not run anything that loads or changes the servers of this installation.
installations.baseUrl: The OpenAI-compatible API without /v1: http://vllm.internal:8000. A path is allowed behind a reverse proxy.
installations.kind: Glafira recognizes vLLM and SGLang by their answers. Choose by hand only if detection is wrong; other servers work as OpenAI-compatible.
installations.apiKey: The --api-key of the server. Kept in the system secret store, not in a file; sent as Authorization: Bearer.
installations.metricsPath: Where the server exposes Prometheus metrics: /metrics; SGLang needs --enable-metrics.
installations.ca: System store — the CAs this computer trusts. Listed certificates — only them, the system ones are not used.
installations.proxy: System — the HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY variables. Or an explicit address such as http://proxy:3128.
installations.test: Checks this server step by step with the values of the form, without saving: address, TLS, /health, API key, type, version, models.
installations.detectedKind: The type Glafira works with. If it differs from what the server looks like, the type is chosen in the installation or the server version is too old.

form.name: Name
form.apiKeyKeep: leave empty to keep the saved key
form.apiKeyOverHttp: The address is http:// — the API key will be sent unencrypted
form.insecureWarning: The server certificate is not verified: anyone on the way can read the API key and the traffic
form.insecureForbidden: Servers without certificate verification are forbidden by your organization
form.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and the API keys of its servers?
